screening_decisions.reason: RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in aortic surgery patients without bleeding disorders. Assesses perioperative blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in total hip replacement patients. Assesses blood loss outcomes. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a meta-analysis, not a primary RCT. Selection criteria specify inclusion of randomised controlled trials, not systematic reviews or meta-analyses.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs aprotinin vs no treatment in CPB surgery patients. DDAVP is compared to an active comparator (aprotinin). Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in CABG patients. Patients on aspirin do not have inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs no treatment in orthognathic surgery patients with normal coagulation profiles. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery patients selected by hemoSTATUS test (not inherited bleeding disorders). Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs saline, but primary outcome is von Willebrand factor activity, not blood loss or transfusion requirements. Does not meet protocol outcome criteria.
This is clinical guidance document, not an RCT. Does not meet study design criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in hip replacement patients with normal bleeding time. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings.
RCT but patients had 'overt bleeding and a prolonged bleeding time' at baseline, suggesting possible bleeding disorder or coagulopathy. May not meet 'patients without bleeding disorders' criterion.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs saline control in valvular heart surgery patients. Assesses blood loss outcomes. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT but patients have cirrhosis with documented coagulopathy (platelet counts 30,000-50,000/microL and/or INR 2.0-3.0). These patients have bleeding disorders and are excluded by protocol.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in hemostatically normal patients undergoing total joint arthroplasty. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs no treatment in cholecystectomy patients on aspirin. Aspirin use does not constitute inherited bleeding disorder. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs saline in endoscopic sinus surgery patients. Assesses blood loss outcomes. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in spinal fusion patients with normal hemostatic function. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery patients on aspirin. Aspirin use does not constitute inherited bleeding disorder. Meets selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs aprotinin vs placebo in CPB surgery patients. DDAVP compared to active comparator (aprotinin). Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in CABG patients. Part of larger trial on DDAVP in cardiac surgery. Meets selection criteria despite focus on hemodynamic effects.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in CPB surgery patients. Assesses blood loss and transfusion outcomes. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings on total blood loss.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in spinal fusion patients described as hemostatically normal. Meets all selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP vs placebo in CABG patients. Assesses blood loss and transfusion outcomes. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings.
This is a systematic review/meta-analysis, not a primary RCT. Additionally, it compares transfusion strategies, not DDAVP intervention. Does not meet selection criteria.
Methodological paper about statistical tests for meta-analysis. Not an RCT and not about DDAVP intervention. Does not meet selection criteria.
RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo in cardiac surgery (CABG) patients. Examines blood loss and blood product replacement. No inherited bleeding disorders mentioned. Meets all inclusion criteria.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery. Examines postoperative blood losses and red cell transfusion requirements. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Double-blind, randomized study of DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery. Evaluates bleeding, blood loss, and replacement therapy. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Letter about pain management during intravenous line placement in children. Does not evaluate DDAVP for perioperative blood loss or transfusion. Wrong intervention and topic.

Randomized, blinded comparison of desmopressin vs placebo in pediatric cardiac surgery patients. Examines blood loss and blood replacement. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP vs placebo in cardiac surgery with extracorporeal circulation. Examines postoperative blood loss. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Retrospective cohort study of patients who declined transfusions for religious reasons. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP intervention.
Randomized trial evaluating desmopressin for thromboprophylaxis after catheterization. Primary outcome is thrombosis prevention, not blood loss or transfusion reduction. Wrong outcome.

Double-blind RCT of desmopressin vs placebo for percutaneous kidney biopsy. Examines bleeding complications. Patients had normal coagulation parameters (no inherited bleeding disorders). Meets all inclusion criteria.
Guidelines document about von Willebrand disease diagnosis and management. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP for perioperative blood loss.
Double-blind, randomized clinical trial of desmopressin vs placebo in scoliosis surgery. Evaluates blood loss. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.

Randomized double-blind trial of desmopressin vs placebo in hip arthroplasty. Examines blood loss and red cell transfusion requirements. Rheumatoid arthritis is not an inherited bleeding disorder. Meets all inclusion criteria.

RCT examining DDAVP for blood transfusion reduction in cardiac surgery patients with aspirin-induced platelet dysfunction. Drug-induced platelet dysfunction is not an inherited bleeding disorder. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Review article about desmopressin efficacy in haematological disorders. Not an RCT, does not provide primary data on perioperative blood loss.
Appears to be a report on kidney biopsy RCT comparing desmopressin vs placebo. Examines bleeding complications. Meets inclusion criteria for RCT evaluating DDAVP for bleeding reduction.
Review article about transfusion reactions. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP intervention.
Placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial of DDAVP vs placebo in burn débridement and grafting surgery. Examines blood loss. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin vs placebo in cardiac surgery. Examines postoperative blood loss and blood product replacement. No inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Survey study of RBC utilization patterns. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP intervention.
Retrospective cohort study of reoperation for bleeding after CABG. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP intervention.
Guidelines document for platelet transfusions. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP intervention.

Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin vs placebo in cardiac surgery patients with active bleeding. Examines transfusion requirements and blood loss. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Methodological paper about funnel plots and meta-analysis bias detection. Not an RCT, does not evaluate DDAVP intervention.
Review article about cellular mechanisms of desmopressin. Not an RCT, does not provide primary data on perioperative blood loss or transfusion.

Randomized, prospective, double-blind clinical trial of desmopressin vs placebo in spinal cord injury patients undergoing flap reconstruction. Examines blood loss and transfusion requirements. Patients were hemostatically normal (no inherited bleeding disorders). Meets all inclusion criteria.

Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in adults undergoing elective CABG. Meets all inclusion criteria: RCT design, DDAVP vs placebo, perioperative setting, adults, no inherited bleeding disorders.
